name: Flux
description: Flux is a website template for plumbing and heating companies that take emergency calls and planned work, with a hero that splits visitors into a leak right now, with the emergency number, and planned work, an emergency section where the visitor picks a district and sees the estimated arrival time, planned work with duration and cost, indicative prices, a four stage process with job photos, reviews and FAQ. A bold Sora typeface and a clear emergency call to action give the website a fast, dependable character. Replace the copy, photos, districts, prices and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with two paths: a leak right now with the emergency number, or planned work
Planned work with duration and cost for six kinds of jobs
Four stage process with photos from jobs
Customer reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
FAQ about call-out fees, invoices and warranty
Recent jobs page with scope and location
